name: codeeraser
description: CodeEraser passive guard (0.x preview): a winnowing clone index behind a per-project daemon intercepts T1/T2 duplicate writes at PreToolUse, audits net LOC + touched duplicates at Stop, and reports health at SessionStart. Gradual modes observe/warn/ask/deny via ce.toml [guard]; every event feeds .ce/observe.ndjson. Preview is air-gapped: requires a locally installed `ce` binary on PATH (cargo install --path cli); SHA256-pinned binary download ships at M7 per ADR-007.
